Alger, 26 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 26, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Huawei Algeria formalized cooperation agreements with eight universities and higher schools on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. These partnerships, signed with the Ministry of Higher Education, aim to strengthen the ties between the academic world and the technology sector.
